workflow-992c0d41-6a21-4429-8e07-b5a0806.goal: Rebuild the previously blocked commercial feedback-loop slice against the current authoritative control context so LeadFinder can learn from Callflow outcomes without PII. The immediate goal is measurement and explainable calibration evidence, not an opaque model: identify which observable LeadFinder signals correlate with useful commercial outcomes and make the aggregate available for future ranking adjustments. Never include phone, email, free-form notes, personal names, credentials or inferred sales outcomes; do not automatically change ranking weights until there is sufficient outcome data. Add tests and concise docs, and preserve all production/merge safety gates.

workflow-7b70e64d-844b-41bf-a1c2-69964e4.goal: Implement a zero-cost agent-to-ChatGPT supervisor handoff inbox so the MSI agent can escalate blockers, request review/prioritization, and leave concise status questions without requiring the user to relay them. Use GitHub as the durable mailbox. Define a strict machine-readable marker/protocol (for example assistant-handoff:v1), deduplicate requests, include lane/project/issue/PR/evidence/reason/urgency, and allow a supervisor response to be consumed idempotently by the agent. The agent must continue autonomously when no human/supervisor judgment is required and only escalate bounded cases. Add visibility in Control Center for pending/resolved handoffs if feasible. No paid APIs, no browser automation of ChatGPT, no secrets in issue bodies, no weakened approvals, no production deploy.

workflow-1c62e4fc-774e-4f02-aa52-db5bd2f.goal: Implement governed safe auto-merge for agent-authored PRs now that the operator authorizes autonomous merges. Use existing free GitHub/MSI infrastructure only; no paid APIs.

workflow-32ebc11e-068c-4e5f-8c50-07c84c7.goal: Extend Agent Control with a second safe remote-command layer: allow changing priority for queued agent tasks, retrying/requeueing one failed or blocked task when its request is still valid, and show a compact PR/supervisor panel with check state, mergeability, sensitive-change hold reason, and pending agent-to-supervisor handoffs.
